_readme: The bench the hw tests run on, as data: which output drives which input, with the probe/vdiv/offset the capture must be configured for and the signal it must then see. Rewiring the bench means editing this file, never a test. A link that is not declared here is not guessed: the test that needs it skips and names what is declared. Checked offline by tests/unit/test_bench_declaration.py; used by tests/hardware (marker: hw).

awg_to_a0.summary: M454 AWG (MCX output) straight into analog channel A0, direct coax, no probe, no divider
awg_to_a0._tolerance_note: level_v is the absolute slack on the declared levels: it covers the generator's own accuracy and an uncalibrated 8-bit ADC (measured 3.13 Vpp for a 3 V program), while a wrong probe or a divider is a factor of 10 out (2.7 V) and still fails

undeclared: calibration output (1 kHz, front panel pin) -> any channel
